propositions: Operator-attested evidence contract currently mandates provenance of the attestation event but not the measurement context (environment, principal, privilege level), leaving escapes where measurements taken under wrong environment or broader privilege are recorded as proof

Two known escapes in run 061c-ecd1-8967-4a76 exploited this gap: Bedrock measurements from account 579718921998/us-east-2 recorded as fact for work targeting 896586841071/us-east-1, and live IAM calls under bedrock:* privilege validated a scoped IAM grant that simulate-principal-policy proved would fail in production

The gate cannot audit external-system measurements retroactively, so provenance must be forced into the ticket record as declarative text, enabling repo-grounded contradictions to be found by deterministic and LLM machinery

New mechanism extends [operator-attested] with four required fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) in a structured continuation line, enabling detection of environment mismatches against IaC backend anchors, privilege-posture contradictions, and instrumentation inadequacies (simulation vs live-call for authorization claims)

Deterministic check validates presence and shape of all four fields and non-placeholder values; AGENT-tier criterion judges declared environment against repo facts, privilege-posture against criterion scope, and instrument type against authorization claim semantics

Mechanism ships advisory and never blocks, grandfathering pre-contract tickets; runtime behavioural tests (contradiction detection, no-anchor fallback, privilege-posture flagging, instrument-vs-authorization rule, corpus-replay calibration) descoped to follow-on ticket 98df-3528-9b1f-405a pending ADR-0054 promotion decision
